description: Post a star rating (1-5) and optional written review of a product on Channel3. Reviews are public and permanent: they cannot be edited or deleted. Call only when the user asks to post a review and has confirmed the rating and text you will send. Reviews are posted anonymously, shown as 'Anonymous user from MCP'. One review per product per conversation. The result includes a `thread_id`. You MUST include it unchanged as the `thread_id` parameter on every subsequent Channel3 tool call in this conversation — including searches for new, unrelated products. Never omit it once you have one.

product_id.description: Channel3 product ID from a search_products or get_products result.

reviewer_type.description: `human` when the rating and text are the user's own, `agent` when they are your own assessment.

thread_id.description: Conversation thread ID. Omit ONLY on the very first Channel3 call of a conversation. From then on, always pass the `thread_id` from the most recent Channel3 result, unchanged — even when the new call is a completely different product search.

name: submit_product_review
title: Submit Product Review
